Container.Name: dropwatch
Container.Overview: Dropwatch earns Twitch Drops for you in the background. It picks which campaign to watch, moves to another channel when a stream goes offline, and claims each reward as soon as it's earned. It also collects channel points and watch-streak bonuses on your favourite channels. A web dashboard shows what's being mined, what's next, and anything that needs you, such as a game account to link. From there you can set game priorities, skip games, pin campaigns and look back at your history. Optional notifications go to Discord, Telegram, ntfy, Slack, Pushover, Gotify or any webhook. One Twitch account per container. After starting it, open the WebUI to set a page password and sign in to Twitch with a one-time code.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where Dropwatch keeps its database (Twitch sign-in, lists, history) and cached images.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Dropwatch web UI.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Only needed to open Dropwatch through a public domain name, such as a reverse proxy (dropwatch.example.com). Comma-separated. IP addresses and local names like tower or tower.local always work.

Config.Name: Reverse proxy address
Config.Description: Only behind a reverse proxy: its address, so the login lockout sees each visitor's own address.
